title: GitHub
description: Read and file GitHub issues and read files from repositories, through the GitHub REST API with your token.
setup_notes: Create a fine-grained personal access token at github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens with access to the repositories you want, and these permissions: Issues (read and write), Contents (read), Metadata (read). The credential lands disabled: test and enable it under API Credentials, then approve the tools under Persistent Tools.

questions.name: token
questions.label: GitHub token
questions.help: A fine-grained personal access token. It is stored in the credential's secret store and never written into a tool.

recipe.name: github
recipe.description: GitHub REST API, with a personal access token.

recipe.name: github_list_issues
recipe.description: List a repository's issues (pull requests are included by GitHub; they carry a pull_request field).

owner.description: The account or organization that owns the repository.

recipe.name: github_search_issues
recipe.description: Search issues and pull requests across GitHub with GitHub's search syntax, e.g. 'repo:owner/name is:open label:bug crash'.

query.description: The search, in GitHub's issue search syntax.

recipe.name: github_create_issue
recipe.description: Open a new issue in a repository.

owner.description: The account or organization that owns the repository.

recipe.name: github_read_file
recipe.description: Read one file from a repository's default branch, as text.

owner.description: The account or organization that owns the repository.

path.description: The file's path in the repository, e.g. docs/setup.md.
